061        public static interface SalvageDefenderModificationPlugin extends GenericPlugin {
062                float getStrength(SDMParams p, float strength, Random random, boolean withOverride);
063                float getProbability(SDMParams p, float probability, Random random, boolean withOverride);
064                float getQuality(SDMParams p, float quality, Random random, boolean withOverride);
065                float getMaxSize(SDMParams p, float maxSize, Random random, boolean withOverride);
066                float getMinSize(SDMParams p, float minSize, Random random, boolean withOverride);
067                
068                void modifyFleet(SDMParams p, CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random, boolean withOverride);
069                void reportDefeated(SDMParams p, SectorEntityToken entity, CampaignFleetAPI fleet);
070        }
071        
072        public static final String DEFEATED_HYPERSHUNT_COUNT = "$defeatedHypershuntCount";
073        public static final String DEFEATED_DERELICT_STR = "$defeatedDerelictStr";
074        public static final float DEFEATED_TO_ADDED_FACTOR = 0.2f;
075        public static final float DEFEATED_TO_QUALITY_FACTOR = 0.005f;
076        
077        public static class SalvageDefenderModificationPluginImpl extends BaseGenericPlugin implements SalvageDefenderModificationPlugin {
078                public float getStrength(SDMParams p, float strength, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
079                        if (withOverride) return strength;
080                        if (Factions.DERELICT.equals(p.factionId)) {
081                                // Limbo stuff is not affected
082                                if (p.entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$limboWormholeCache") ||
083                                                p.entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean("$limboMiningStation")) {
084                                        return strength;
085                                }
086                                
087                                
088                                float bonus = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(DEFEATED_DERELICT_STR) * DEFEATED_TO_ADDED_FACTOR;
089                                
090                                String type = p.entity.getCustomEntityType();
091                                float limit = 300f;
092                                if (Entities.DERELICT_SURVEY_PROBE.equals(type)) {
093                                        limit = 60;
094                                } else if (Entities.DERELICT_SURVEY_SHIP.equals(type)) {
095                                        limit = 90;
096                                } else if (Entities.DERELICT_MOTHERSHIP.equals(type) || Entities.DERELICT_CRYOSLEEPER.equals(type)) {
097                                        limit = 150;
098                                }
099                                
100        //                      if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
101        //                              bonus = limit;
102        //                      }
103                                
104                                if (bonus > limit) bonus = limit;
105                                return strength + (int) bonus;
106                        }
107                        return strength;
108                }
109                public float getMinSize(SDMParams p, float minSize, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
110                        if (withOverride) return minSize;
111                        return minSize;
112                }
113                public float getMaxSize(SDMParams p, float maxSize, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
114                        if (withOverride) return maxSize;
115                        if (Factions.DERELICT.equals(p.factionId)) {
116                                float bonus = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(DEFEATED_DERELICT_STR) * DEFEATED_TO_ADDED_FACTOR;
117                                String type = p.entity.getCustomEntityType();
118                                float bonusSize = 1;
119                                if (Entities.DERELICT_SURVEY_PROBE.equals(type)) {
120                                        if (bonus >= 5) bonusSize = 2;
121                                }
122                                
123                                return Math.max(maxSize, bonusSize);
124                        }
125                        return maxSize; 
126                }
127                public float getProbability(SDMParams p, float probability, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
128                        if (withOverride) return probability;
129                        if (Factions.DERELICT.equals(p.factionId)) {
130                                String type = p.entity.getCustomEntityType();
131                                float limit = 0f;
132                                if (Entities.DERELICT_SURVEY_PROBE.equals(type)) {
133                                        limit = 60;
134                                } else if (Entities.DERELICT_SURVEY_SHIP.equals(type)) {
135                                        limit = 90;
136                                }
137                                if (limit <= 0 || probability >= 1f) return probability;
138                                
139                                float bonus = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(DEFEATED_DERELICT_STR) * DEFEATED_TO_ADDED_FACTOR;
140                                if (bonus > limit) bonus = limit;
141                                
142                                return probability * (1f - 0.5f * bonus / limit);
143                        }
144                        return probability;
145                }
146                public void reportDefeated(SDMParams p, SectorEntityToken entity, CampaignFleetAPI fleet) {
147                        if (Factions.DERELICT.equals(p.factionId)) {
148                                float total = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(DEFEATED_DERELICT_STR);
149                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(fleet)) {
150                                        //total += FleetFactoryV2.getMemberWeight(member);
151                                        total += member.getFleetPointCost();
152                                }
153                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(DEFEATED_DERELICT_STR, total);
154                        } else if (Factions.OMEGA.equals(p.factionId) && entity != null && entity.hasTag(Tags.CORONAL_TAP)) {
155                                float num = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(DEFEATED_HYPERSHUNT_COUNT);
156                                num++;
157                                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(DEFEATED_HYPERSHUNT_COUNT, num);
158                        }
159                }

161                public void modifyFleet(SDMParams p, CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
162                        if (Factions.OMEGA.equals(fleet.getFaction().getId())) {
163                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
164                                        ShipVariantAPI copy = member.getVariant().clone();
165                                        member.setVariant(copy, false, false);
166                                        copy.addTag(Tags.SHIP_LIMITED_TOOLTIP);

168                                
169                                DropData d;
170                                d = new DropData();
171                                d.chances = 5;
172                                d.maxChances = 7;
173                                d.group = "omega_weapons_small";
174                                d.unaffectedByExtMode = true;
175                                fleet.addDropRandom(d);
176                                
177                                d = new DropData();
178                                d.chances = 3;
179                                d.maxChances = 4;
180                                d.group = "omega_weapons_medium";

195                                        //roles.add(ShipRoles.COMBAT_CAPITAL);
196                                        
197                                        //random = new Random();
198                                        int large = 1 + random.nextInt(2);
199                                        int medium = 2 + random.nextInt(2) + Math.max(0, 2 - large) * 2;
200                                        int small = 3 + random.nextInt(2);
201                                        
202                                        for (int i = 0; i < large; i++) {
203                                                roles.add(ShipRoles.COMBAT_LARGE);
204                                        }
205                                        for (int i = 0; i < medium; i++) {

207                                        }
208                                        for (int i = 0; i < small; i++) {

211                                        
212                                        for (String role : roles) {
213                                                List<ShipRolePick> picks = faction.pickShip(role, params, null, random);
214                                                for (ShipRolePick pick : picks) {
215                                                        FleetMemberAPI member = fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(pick.variantId);

218                                                        RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin.integrateAndAdaptCoreForAIFleet(member);
219                                                }
220                                        }
221                                        
222                                        if (fleet.getInflater() instanceof DefaultFleetInflater) {
223                                                DefaultFleetInflater dfi = (DefaultFleetInflater) fleet.getInflater();
224                                                ((DefaultFleetInflaterParams)dfi.getParams()).allWeapons = true;
225                                                ((DefaultFleetInflaterParams)dfi.getParams()).factionId = Factions.REMNANTS;

227                                        
228                                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
229                                                member.getRepairTracker().setCR(member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
230                                        }
231                                }
232                                
233                                
234                                
235                                long seed = Misc.getSalvageSeed(p.entity);
236                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED, Misc.getRandom(seed, 11).nextLong());
237                        } else
238                        if (Entities.ALPHA_SITE_WEAPONS_CACHE.equals(p.entity.getCustomEntityType())) {

269                                        RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin.integrateAndAdaptCoreForAIFleet(member);
270                                }
271                                
272                                //PersonAPI person = OfficerManagerEvent.createOfficer(fleet.getFaction(), 20, SkillPickPreference.NON_CARRIER, random);
273                                PersonAPI person = plugin.createPerson(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE, fleet.getFaction().getId(), random);

275                                fleet.getFlagship().setCaptain(person);

277

287                                        fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(pick.variantId);
288                                }
289                                AICoreOfficerPlugin plugin = Misc.getAICoreOfficerPlugin(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE);
290                                //PersonAPI person = OfficerManagerEvent.createOfficer(fleet.getFaction(), 20, true, SkillPickPreference.NON_CARRIER, random);
291                                PersonAPI person = plugin.createPerson(Commodities.ALPHA_CORE, fleet.getFaction().getId(), random);
292                                // so it's not the standard alpha core portrait but an older-looking one
293                                person.setPortraitSprite(fleet.getFaction().createRandomPerson().getPortraitSprite());
294                                fleet.setCommander(person);
295                                fleet.getFlagship().setCaptain(person);
296                                RemnantOfficerGeneratorPlugin.integrateAndAdaptCoreForAIFleet(fleet.getFlagship());
297                                
298                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
299                                        member.getRepairTracker().setCR(member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
300                                }
301                        } else
302                        if (Entities.SPEC_LIMBO_WORMHOLE_CACHE.equals(p.entity.getCustomDescriptionId())) {
303                                //fleet.getFleetData().clear();
304                                for (ShipRolePick pick : fleet.getFaction().pickShip(ShipRoles.COMBAT_CAPITAL, ShipPickParams.all(), null, random)) {
305                                        fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(pick.variantId);
306                                }

308                                //PersonAPI person = OfficerManagerEvent.createOfficer(fleet.getFaction(), 20, true, SkillPickPreference.NON_CARRIER, random);
309                                PersonAPI person = plugin.createPerson(Commodities.GAMMA_CORE, fleet.getFaction().getId(), random);
310                                // so it's not the standard alpha core portrait but an older-looking one
311                                //person.setPortraitSprite(fleet.getFaction().createRandomPerson().getPortraitSprite());
312                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {

356                @Override
357                public int getHandlingPriority(Object params) {
358                        if (!(params instanceof SDMParams)) return 0;
359                        SDMParams p = (SDMParams) params;
360                        
361                        if (p.entity != null && p.entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(MiscellaneousThemeGenerator.PLANETARY_SHIELD_PLANET)) {
362                                return 1;
363                        }
364                        if (Factions.DERELICT.equals(p.factionId)) {
365                                return 1;
366                        }
367                        if (Factions.OMEGA.equals(p.factionId)) {
368                                return 1;
369                        }
370                        if (Factions.REMNANTS.equals(p.factionId)) {
371                                return 1;
372                        }
373                        
374                        return -1;
375                }
376                public float getQuality(SDMParams p, float quality, Random random, boolean withOverride) {
377                        if (withOverride) return quality;
378                        if (Factions.DERELICT.equals(p.factionId)) {
379                                float bonus = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getFloat(DEFEATED_DERELICT_STR) * DEFEATED_TO_QUALITY_FACTOR;
380                                return quality + bonus;
381                        }
382                        return quality;
383                }
384        }

386        public boolean execute(String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, final Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
387                if (dialog == null) return false;
388                
389                SectorEntityToken entity = dialog.getInteractionTarget();
390                String specId = entity.getCustomEntityType();
391                if (specId == null || entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().contains(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SPEC_ID_OVERRIDE)) {
392                        specId = entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getString(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SPEC_ID_OVERRIDE);
393                }
394                SalvageEntityGenDataSpec spec = SalvageEntityGeneratorOld.getSalvageSpec(specId);
395                
396                MemoryAPI memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.LOCAL);
397                if (memoryMap.containsKey(MemKeys.ENTITY)) {
398                        memory = memoryMap.get(MemKeys.ENTITY);
399                }
400                
401                long seed = memory.getLong(MemFlags.SALVAGE_SEED);
402                //seed = new Random().nextLong();
403//              if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
404//                      seed = new Random().nextLong();
405//              }
406                
407                // don't use seed directly so that results from different uses of it aren't tied together
408                Random random = Misc.getRandom(seed, 0);
409                
410                DefenderDataOverride override = null;
411                if (memory.contains(MemFlags.SALVAGE_DEFENDER_OVERRIDE)) {
412                        override = (DefenderDataOverride) memory.get(MemFlags.SALVAGE_DEFENDER_OVERRIDE);
413                }
414                
415                Random fleetRandom = Misc.getRandom(seed, 1);
416//              if (Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
417//                      fleetRandom = Misc.random;
418//              }
419                
420                //fleetRandom = new Random();
421                float strength = spec.getMinStr() + Math.round((spec.getMaxStr() - spec.getMinStr()) * fleetRandom.nextFloat());
422                float prob = spec.getProbDefenders();
423                
424                if (override != null) {
425                        strength = override.minStr + Math.round((override.maxStr - override.minStr) * fleetRandom.nextFloat());
426                        prob = override.probDefenders;
427                }
428                
429                String factionId = entity.getFaction().getId();
430                if (spec.getDefFaction() != null) {
431                        factionId = spec.getDefFaction();
432                }
433                if (override != null && override.defFaction != null) {
434                        factionId = override.defFaction;
435                }
436                
437                SDMParams p = new SDMParams();
438                p.entity = entity;
439                p.factionId = factionId;
440                
441                SalvageDefenderModificationPlugin plugin = Global.getSector().getGenericPlugins().pickPlugin(
442                                                                SalvageDefenderModificationPlugin.class, p);
443                
444                if (plugin != null) {
445                        strength = plugin.getStrength(p, strength, random, override != null);
446                        prob = plugin.getProbability(p, prob, random, override != null);
447                }
448                
449                float probStation = spec.getProbStation();
450                if (override != null) {
451                        probStation = override.probStation;
452                }
453                String stationRole = null;
454                if (fleetRandom.nextFloat() < probStation) {
455                        stationRole = spec.getStationRole();
456                        if (override != null && override.stationRole != null) {
457                                stationRole = override.stationRole;
458                        }
459                }
460                
461                //prob = 1f;
462                //strength = 0;
463                
464                if (((int) strength > 0 || stationRole != null) &&  
465                                random.nextFloat() < prob && 
466                                !memory.getBoolean("$defenderFleetDefeated")) {
467                        memory.set("$hasDefenders", true, 0);
468                        
469                        if (!memory.contains("$defenderFleet") || DebugFlags.FORCE_REGEN_AUTOMATED_DEFENSES) {
470                                float quality = spec.getDefQuality();
471                                if (plugin != null) {
472                                        quality = plugin.getQuality(p, quality, fleetRandom, override != null);
473                                }
474                                
475                                FleetParamsV3 fParams = new FleetParamsV3(null, null,
476                                                                factionId,
477                                                                quality,
478                                                                FleetTypes.PATROL_SMALL,
479                                                                (int) strength,
480                                                                0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0);
481                                fParams.random = fleetRandom;
482                                //fParams.withOfficers = false;
483                                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
484                                fParams.withOfficers = faction.getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_OFFICERS_ON_AUTOMATED_DEFENSES);
485                                
486                                fParams.maxShipSize = (int) spec.getMaxDefenderSize();
487                                if (override != null) {
488                                        fParams.maxShipSize = override.maxDefenderSize;
489                                }
490                                
491                                if (plugin != null) {
492                                        fParams.maxShipSize = (int) (plugin.getMaxSize(p, fParams.maxShipSize, random, override != null));
493                                }
494                                
495                                fParams.minShipSize = (int) spec.getMinDefenderSize();
496                                if (override != null) {
497                                        fParams.minShipSize = override.minDefenderSize;
498                                }
499                                if (plugin != null) {
500                                        fParams.minShipSize = (int) (plugin.getMinSize(p, fParams.minShipSize, random, override != null));
501                                }
502                                
503                                //fParams.allowEmptyFleet = true;
504                                
505                                CampaignFleetAPI defenders = FleetFactoryV3.createFleet(fParams);
506                                
507                                if (!defenders.isEmpty()) {
508                                        defenders.getInflater().setRemoveAfterInflating(false);
509                                        
510                                        //defenders.setName(entity.getName() + ": " + "Automated Defenses");
511                                        defenders.setName("Automated Defenses");
512        
513                                        if (stationRole != null) {
514                                                defenders.getFaction().pickShipAndAddToFleet(stationRole, ShipPickParams.all(), defenders, fleetRandom);
515                                                defenders.getFleetData().sort();
516                                        }
517                                        
518                                        defenders.clearAbilities();
519                                        
520                                        if (plugin != null) {
521                                                //System.out.println("NEXT: " + fleetRandom.nextLong());
522                                                plugin.modifyFleet(p, defenders, fleetRandom, override != null);
523                                        }
524                                        
525                                        defenders.getFleetData().sort();
526                                        
527                                        memory.set("$defenderFleet", defenders, 0);
528                                        
529                                } else {
530                                        memory.set("$hasDefenders", false, 0);
531                                }
532                        }
533                        
534                        
535                        CampaignFleetAPI defenders = memory.getFleet("$defenderFleet");
536                        if (defenders != null) {
537                                boolean hasStation = false;
538                                boolean hasNonStation = false;
539                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : defenders.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
540                                        if (member.isStation()) {
541                                                hasStation = true;
542                                        } else {
543                                                hasNonStation = true;
544                                        }
545                                }
546                                memory.set("$hasStation", hasStation, 0);
547                                memory.set("$hasNonStation", hasNonStation, 0);
548                                
549                                defenders.setLocation(entity.getLocation().x, entity.getLocation().y);
550                                
551                                //Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().restartEncounterMusic(entity);
552                        }
553                } else {
554                        memory.set("$hasDefenders", false, 0);
555                        memory.set("$hasStation", false, 0);
556                }

558                //memory.set("$hasSalvageSpecial", false, 0);
559                //memory.set("$salvageSpecialData", null, 0);
560                //memory.set("$salvageSpecialData", new DomainSurveyDerelictSpecialData(SpecialType.SCRAMBLED), 0);
561                
562        
563                return true;
564        }
